submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on the token that names a concrete story object, place, or quantity the narrative is currently describing (a telephone, a battery, an x-ray, numbers, a bank, a price), or on the copula or verb immediately after such a noun when the sentence says what the thing is like or what happens to it. It stays quiet on other nouns, on pronouns, and on the words around the firing token.
